Start with the plain-language section. Use the source tables at the bottom only when you need a link or a date.

## In plain language

Hong Kong is trying to build a **low-altitude economy**: flying tasks such as inspection, delivery and, later, other services, generally below 1,000 metres. This page records what the government has actually decided. It is not a market forecast.

### Who is in charge?

A **Working Group**, led by the Deputy Financial Secretary, coordinates policy. The **Civil Aviation Department** enforces the Small Unmanned Aircraft Order (Cap. 448G), the main Hong Kong law for drones. A full **Action Plan** has been promised again in the **2026 Policy Address** (¶139); the published text is still not available.

### Two different trial schemes

**Regulatory Sandbox** (first cohort). Industry and public bodies proposed 72 projects. The government selected **38** on 20 March 2025. These are supervised trials, not an open market. Beyond-visual-line-of-sight flying in this scheme follows Civil Aviation Department circular AC-013.

**Regulatory Sandbox X** is a later, harder scheme (announced November 2025). It covers more complex tests, including traffic-management demonstrations and possible cross-boundary flights. Circular AC-017 covers cross-boundary trials inside Sandbox X. Results of those cross-boundary trials have **not** been published.

Do not add 38 to the Sandbox X module counts. They are not the same programme.

### Radio spectrum

From 27 October 2025, a dedicated band (**1430–1444 MHz**) can be licensed for Sandbox projects. It is not a general public mobile band.

### The HK$350 billion figure

Our Hong Kong Foundation, a think tank, projected about **HK$350 billion** of **industry value-added in Hong Kong by 2050**. That is not a government forecast and not this year’s output. If you use the number, name the Foundation, the metric, the place, and the year 2050.

### Mainland rules, in one paragraph

Unmanned-aircraft operations on the Mainland still rest on the 2024 State Council rules and CCAR-92. A revised Civil Aviation Law took effect on **1 July 2026**. A 2026 draft on air-traffic rules (Chapter 12) is only a consultation text.

### Greater Bay Area

Guangdong has a published policy target. Shenzhen has run **domestic** medical-sample flights. An **operating** Shenzhen–Hong Kong medical drone corridor is **not** documented. Officials have described it as planned or on trial under Sandbox X.

### What you still must not write

Do not write that the government estimates HK$350 billion. Do not invent a Hong Kong vertiport statute, a published Action Plan, or a completed cross-boundary corridor.

## Two trial programmes

The first Sandbox selected 38 of 72 proposals (20 March 2025). Sandbox X is a later, harder programme. Cross-boundary results are not yet published.

|-----------|----------------|--------|------|------|

| **[Regulatory Sandbox X](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202511/24/P2025112400912.htm)** | Launch **2025-11-24**; batches UTM **15** / unconventional aircraft **4** / shared **5** / others **9**; cross-boundary **OPEN** | CE / WG / TLB | T1/T2 | [AC-017](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-017.pdf) = cross-boundary in Sandbox X (PDF 2026-04-24, T1) |

> Regulatory Sandbox ≠ Sandbox X. Counts are **38** + module batches — not a blended “32.”

**Allowed wording** (OHKF, *Taking Flight…*, Sep 2025; an OHKF projection, not a government figure):

> OHKF (Sep 2025) projects ~HK$350 billion **industry value-added** in Hong Kong by 2050 (majority from supporting services).

**Banned:** “Government estimates HK$350bn…” / classroom tickets, HHI, CASK, flights / vendor “GBA trillion.”

## Mainland rules

For operations today, cite 国令761 and CCAR-92. The 2025 Civil Aviation Law is in force from 1 July 2026; the ATM Chapter 12 text is still a draft.

| Instrument | Effective | Tier |
|------------|-----------|------|
| [Civil Aviation Law (2025 revision), Order No. 65](https://www.caac.gov.cn/XXGK/XXGK/FLFG/202512/t20251227_229597.html) | **2026-07-01** | T1 |
| [Interim UAS Ordinance 国令761](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202306/content_6888800.htm) | **2024-01-01** | T1 |
| [CCAR-92](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/2020/jigou/fgs/202401/t20240103_3980642.html) | **2024-01-01** | T1 |
| [National Airspace Basic Classification (G / W)](http://www.caac.gov.cn/XXGK/XXGK/TZTG/202312/t20231221_222397.html) | Released **2023-12-21** | T1 |
| [CAAC ATM Rules (征求意见稿) — Ch.12 UAS](https://www.caac.gov.cn/HDJL/YJZJ/202608/t20260811_231462.html) | **Draft** **2026-08-11**; comments **closed 2026-09-11**; CAAC; **not** promulgated; not Art.34/225 decree | T1 |

## Greater Bay Area

A domestic Shenzhen blood-delivery trial is documented. An operating Shenzhen–Hong Kong medical corridor is not.

| [Shenzhen domestic blood UAS](https://wjw.sz.gov.cn/szsxyzx/xxgk/xwdt/content/post_11129733.html) | Evidenced; **not** cross-border | 2024-01-19 | T1/T2 |

## What not to write

No official text yet for the Action Plan, a Hong Kong vertiport statute, or Sandbox X cross-boundary results. Smart TMS from **2028** and >150 kg drafting **within 2027** are PA Annex work indicators, not effective law dates.

WG gazetted instrument beyond PA + first meeting; Cap.448G s.12(2)(c) appointment; Sandbox X cross-boundary results; Action Plan **published** text; Pigovian drone taxes; Vertiport HK statutory definition.
